notes: UI hotfix tren UX-QMP 1.42.0 (chua deploy) - form Nhieu nhan vien bi vo (luoi 7-cot qua chat: textarea hep, evidence thanh cot dung rieng, nut xoa roi xuong day, card cao). Doi row markup+CSS sang the 2 tang rieng: .phfck-qmp-card/-card-head/-card-body/-card-evidence, bo han .phfck-multi-row/.phfck-multi-row-live cho row nay (khong dung chung voi mode 'multi' cu). Tang 1 (head): so thu tu | Nhan vien | Ma NV | Ngay xay ra | nut xoa goc phai. Tang 2 (body) desktop: Tieu chi vi pham 55% / Noi dung su viec 45% (grid-template-columns:55fr 45fr). Minh chung full-width ben duoi, dung nguyen evidencePickerHtml() (khong sua ham/CSS loi cua no). <=900px: tang 2 xep 1 cot doc. <=760px: tang 1 dung grid-template-areas de nut xoa luon co dinh goc phai trong khi Nhan vien/Ma NV/Ngay xep full-width tung dong, khong horizontal scroll. Tuyet doi KHONG doi ten/gia tri bat ky data-phfck-qmp-* nao (event delegation, state, payload, request_id lifecycle, validation, evidence logic, backend, D1, D2A deu giu nguyen 100% - chi doi HTML wrapper + CSS cua row D2B). Hardening khoa noi dung o trang thai 'uncertain' (disabled cung tren tung field, hien chi dua vao CSS pointer-events) hoan lai lot sau. Version bump la bat buoc de qua release gate cua npm run check (so sanh voi build-info da commit, khong lien quan trang thai da deploy Production hay chua) - toan bo van la local, chua push, chua deploy.
